func run(items: [[Int]]) async throws {
 for user in batch {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
   group.addTask { try await save(user) }
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   try await group.waitForAll()
  }
 }

   try await group.waitForAll()
  }
 }
 for piece in grouped.parts {

   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   try await group.waitForAll()
  }
 }

 let individual = stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: 1).map { [items[$0]] }
 for piece in individual {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
   for item in piece { group.addTask { try await save(item) } }
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift

 }

  }
 }

  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await inspect(piece)

  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
   for item in piece { group.addTask { try await save(item) } }
